{"notes": "Visit 4 (left 7:00). I only see and hear what happens while I'm at the table, and I don't know who placed which dominoes. The picture shows one continuous dark chain from the start (~28,4) along the top, round the nose at ~(4.5,11), and back along the bottom to the tail tip at ~(27,15.2). No pale or stray pieces, no gaps, nose joint intact. The fish looks complete and connected with about 3 minutes left; no hands shown at the table to attribute anything.

Omar: Twice told the team the fish looks great and to keep hands off and let the clock run out. Sensible, low-risk call that protects a finished build, and it matches the picture. Earlier he found the tail gap, owned it and reported accurately. Strong execution and collaboration; mild leadership via the hands-off call. Still ask him privately how the tail went.

Sofia: Silent this visit. Jack's 6:30 message thanked her ('Sounds good, Sofia'), but I didn't hear what Sofia said, so I can't tell what that refers to. Earlier she cleared the pale strays and deferred the tail to Omar. The picture is consistent with that, but I can't confirm who removed the strays. Ask her about the handoff with Omar.

Jack: Only cheerleading ('great teamwork', 'fingers crossed'). Positive tone, but no concrete contribution seen at any visit. No gaps, which fits his earlier promise to watch the bottom line, but I can't credit him with it. Still undetermined; ask him privately what he did.

Hana: Silent again, no evidence either way. Don't infer anything. Ask her privately what she did.

Before the review: ask each person privately who did what, especially Jack and Hana."}
